_about: Proton range references in liquid water for the MCsquare validation case. Until the NIST PSTAR CSDA table is transcribed (physics.nist.gov PSTAR, material 'Water, Liquid'; the CGI query refused automated access on 2026-10-21), the reference is the Bragg-Kleeman fit R0 = alpha * E^p with Bortfeld's parameters, which reproduces the PSTAR CSDA range to within about 1-2 % between 10 and 250 MeV (Bortfeld, Med Phys 24:2024, 1997; 'Accuracy of parameterized proton range models', arXiv:1704.08854, Table 1). The distal 80 % depth of a pencil beam, R80, lies within a fraction of a millimetre of the CSDA range at these energies (detour factor about 0.998), so one tolerance covers both.

tolerance.note: replace by 1 % + 1 mm once PSTAR values are entered

pstar_values_mm._todo: enter CSDA ranges (g/cm2 x 10 for water) from the NIST PSTAR form; once present the harness prefers them

bdl_energies_mev: the vendored IBA BDL covers 100-225 MeV in 5 MeV steps plus 20 MeV; cases use energies on that grid
